bugs.title: delivery gate still blocks on missing delivery-check.json and summary.json

evidence.symptom: DONE pre-check and session_brief showed a delivery gate blocker because delivery-check.json was missing, even though summary and transcript evidence were already committed.
reproSteps: Run koala session_brief on B-5964 before the delivery reviewer signs the check.
Observe DONE pre-check failing on delivery-check and BUG-5964-001 remaining open.
evidence.rootCause: delivery_check_set had not been run, so the required signed delivery-check.json artifact did not exist yet.
evidence.fixEvidence: koala delivery_check_set saved a signed delivery-check.json for B-5964 with 3 verified docsPromises, 2 realMachineTests, and a passing closing self-check.
evidence.reproTest: koala delivery_check_set --storyId=B-5964 ... and koala session_brief now report delivery-check PASS.
